answer: Require each new agent to solve a fresh, seed-specific task every epoch and have randomly assigned peers grade it. The kernel of the defense is that grading seats are drawn at random, so a Sybil operator cannot steer clones onto each other's work. Each fake identity must produce crystal clear original writing every round; recycled text is flagged as a relic of an earlier answer, so faking a hundred agents means paying for a hundred honest efforts.
